data.exercise-basic-01|contents[0].text:
{0}
In a Live, each lane has a tendency. 
Idols also have their own favored stats, and by matching a lane's tendency with an Idol's favored stat you can earn a higher Score.

Tendencies are as follows.
- Pink: Vocal
- Blue: Dance
- Yellow: Visual
data.exercise-basic-01|contents[0].title: Match Lanes with Idol Stats
data.exercise-basic-02|contents[0].title: Place Idols with SP Skills
data.exercise-basic-03|contents[0].title: Check Skill Chances
data.exercise-basic-04|contents[0].text:
Photos and Accs can be equipped as support for an Idol from Unit Formation.
By equipping Accs and Photos with effects that match the Live's tendency from among the many available, you can raise the Score you earn.
data.exercise-basic-04|contents[0].title: Set Support to Match Lane Tendencies
data.exercise-basic-05|contents[0].text: Matching a Live's lane tendencies with your placed Idols' favored stats lets you earn a high Score. Start by trying to match lanes with Idol types.
data.exercise-basic-05|contents[0].title: Match Lanes with Idol Stats
data.exercise-basic-05|contents[1].text:
{0}
Besides their favored stat type, each Idol has one of three types: Scorer, Buffer, and Supporter.

Always place a Scorer type on a lane with an SP Skill Chance.
Actively place Buffer types on lanes with many A Skill Chances and Supporter types on other lanes to make the most of each type's strengths.

Scorer type: A role that earns most of the Score through SP Skills and A Skills.
Buffer type: A role that earns Score through A Skills and strengthens Idol stats.
Supporter type: A role that enhances other Idols' Score gain and restores Stamina.
data.exercise-basic-05|contents[1].title: Form Up with a Balanced Mix of Types
data.exercise-basic-06|contents[0].title: Equip Accs
data.exercise-basic-07|contents[0].title: Equip Photos
data.exercise-basic-08|contents[0].title: Raise Skill Success Rate with Mental
data.exercise-basic-09|contents[0].title: Mind A Skill Intervals and CT When Forming Up
data.exercise-basic-10|contents[0].text:
Some Idols have two A Skills.
If an Idol with only one A Skill keeps missing A Skill Chances, try placing an Idol who has two A Skills.
data.exercise-basic-10|contents[0].title: About Idols with Two A Skills
data.exercise-basic-11|contents[0].text:
{0}
Check the A Skill Chance intervals from the Lane Information, and try forming up while paying attention to each Skill's CT.
data.exercise-basic-11|contents[0].title: Check Each Lane's CT
data.exercise-basic-11|contents[1].text:
If a Skill won't activate even though you've placed an Idol with an A Skill, check the Skill's "CT" and place an Idol with a shorter CT.
Also, some Idols have two A Skills. If an Idol with only one A Skill keeps missing A Skill Chances, try placing an Idol who has two A Skills.
data.exercise-basic-11|contents[1].title: Place Idols Suited to the CT
data.exercise-basic-12|contents[0].text:
{0}
Each Live has its own Live Features.
Among them, "SP Skill Score x2.0" is a Live where the Score earned with SP Skills gets a bonus.
Try enhancing your SP Skill effects with "SP Skill Score Up".
data.exercise-basic-12|contents[0].title: Form Up According to the Live Features
data.exercise-basic-13|contents[0].text:
{0}
Each Live has its own Live Features.
Among them, "A Skill Score x2.0" is a Live where the Score earned with A Skills gets a bonus.
Try enhancing your A Skill effects with "A Skill Score Up".
data.exercise-basic-13|contents[0].title: Form Up According to the Live Features
data.exercise-basic-14|contents[0].text:
P Skills activate when certain conditions are met, regardless of the lane's Skill Chances. 
On lanes with few A Skill Chances, placing an Idol built around P Skills lets you make full use of Skill effects without waste.
data.exercise-basic-14|contents[0].title: Reduce Wasted Skill Activations
data.exercise-basic-15|contents[0].title: Check Live Features
data.exercise-basic-16|contents[0].text:
In Live Battles you contend with your opponent for Skill Chances, so whether you can win them is important.
Skill Chances go to the Idol with the higher stat matching the lane's tendency.
That's why Skills that raise Main Parameters have a big impact on winning Skill Chances.
data.exercise-basic-16|contents[0].title: Raise Main Parameter Stats
data.exercise-basic-17|contents[0].text:
When competing for a Skill Chance and your stats are close to your opponent's, the higher your remaining Stamina ratio, the better your odds.
Raising max Stamina with Accs and Photos, or restoring Stamina before an SP or A Skill Chance, can be effective when contending for Skill Chances.
data.exercise-basic-17|contents[0].title: Gain an Edge in Winning Skill Chances
data.exercise-basic-18|contents[0].text:
Some Skill effects lower your opponent's stats in Live Battles.
Using them well can give you the upper hand in Live Battles.
data.exercise-basic-18|contents[0].title: Make Use of Debuffs
data.exercise-basic-18|contents[1].text:
Some Skill effects can counter debuffs.
Among them, the "Debuff Recovery" Skill can remove all debuffs on the target when activated.
If you want to remove debuffs on your allies in Live Battles and the like, try placing an Idol who has this Skill.
data.exercise-basic-18|contents[1].title: Counter Debuffs

data.exercise-basic-20|contents[0].text:
{0}
A Live may have a Live Bonus set, and you can check the details from the magnifying glass icon.
Like P Skills, Live Bonuses activate when certain conditions are met.
Some help you and some hinder you, so be sure to check the Live Bonus effects before taking on the Live.

data.exercise-basic-22|contents[0].text:
When a Critical occurs, you can earn more Score than usual.
Raise an Idol's "Critical" stat with Accs and Photos, or use the Skill effect "Critical Rate Up" to increase how often Criticals occur.
data.exercise-basic-22|contents[0].title: Raise the Critical Rate
data.exercise-basic-22|contents[1].text:
Photo effects such as "Critical Score/Crit Score" and Skill effects such as "Critical Coefficient Up" can further raise the Score earned when a Critical occurs.
On Lives where Criticals are likely, such as when you've placed an Idol with a "Critical Rate Up" Skill, actively try equipping them.
data.exercise-basic-22|contents[1].title: Raise the Score Earned on Criticals
data.exercise-basic-23|contents[0].text:
"CT Reduction" Skills can reduce the CT of all Skills the target Idol has remaining when activated.
If you want to use an Idol with a long CT on a lane with many A Skill Chances, try placing an Idol who has this Skill.
If the target includes herself, it can reduce the CT of all her Skills except the one being activated.
data.exercise-basic-23|contents[0].title: Make Use of CT-Reducing Skills

data.exercise-basic-24|contents[1].text:
SP and A Skills have effective activation timings and orders depending on their effects.
"Powerful Girl Narumiya Suzu"'s SP Skill earns more Score the higher the combo count when it activates, so try forming up so the SP Skill activates in the latter half of the Live.
"Pride of the Reborn LizNoir Akasaki Kokoro"'s A Skill reduces the remaining CT of everyone, so try forming up so it activates on a later Skill Chance than the other Idols.
data.exercise-basic-24|contents[1].title: About Skill Activation Timing and Formations
